$description: Single source of the project palette. Values are the official Audi Revolut F1 Team tokens (audif1.com CSS, --color-af1-*), read 2026-10-08. Change colors here only; tokens.css, the app theme and the WORKFLOW tab block derive from this file.

graphite.use: cards and surfaces; text on light

graphite-hover.use: hairlines, raised surfaces; secondary text on light

grey-03.use: disabled and decorative only, never text

chalk.use: primary text on dark; light background

lava.use: the single accent: key number, active state, thin rule

lava-ink.use: red buttons with white label; red text on light

heading.note: Audi Type is proprietary; swap here if the organizers provide the brand kit

rules: Dark-first: carbon page, graphite cards, chalk text.
One red element per screen or slide at most.
Lava as text only on carbon (4.85:1). On light backgrounds use lava-ink.
White label only on lava-ink buttons (5.0:1), not on lava (3.7:1, large text only).
No gradients, glow, neon or drop shadows. 1px hairlines in graphite-hover.
